column1: # cenfuse benchmark, genomes added in 0.17 (benchmark/truth_017.tsv), one row per scored chromosome-run: 592 rows, 39 runs, 22 genomes; cenfuse 0.17.0. Scored by benchmark/score.py with benchmark/truth_017.tsv. Read: docs/benchmark.md#genomes-added-in-017
# Coordinates: 1-based, inclusive (as cenfuse's <genome>.centromeres.tsv); truth start = truth BED start + 1. gap_bp: bp between call and truth (0 = overlap or touch); tol_bp: the gap allowed
# outcome: right_high/right_medium/right_low | conf_wrong (wrong high or medium) | wrong_low | none (no call); holocentric controls: any call is wrong, any confident call confidently wrong
# arm: F FASTA only, T + tes/ (LTR annotation), H + Hi-C, TH + tes/ + Hi-C, ALL every input of the genome
